The BNE viewer shows no gloss at overview size; the decipherment recorded in print is a pencil interlinear in the hand of Granvelle's secretary, which I could not see at viewer resolution.

1266.note: Only one of ten letters is ciphered: MSS/7909/178 (Mary of Hungary, 30 Oct 1546) has a short passage of about 75 signs in three lines, partly glossed in the left margin ('pour les faire partir sans quelque advertissement'), so it is a contemporary partial decipherment, and the passage is too short to stand as a target.
1266.closed: Contemporary marginal decipherment on the cipher passage of MSS/7909/178; the cipher is three lines (about 75 signs) in an otherwise clear French letter; the other letters seen (7909/177, 179) are in clear.

seen.where: BNE Digital, Cartas de la Reina de Hungria al Cardenal Granvela, MSS/7909/177-187 (card https://bnedigital.bne.es/bd/card?oid=0000173419&site=bdh): viewers of MSS/7909/177, 178 and 179 opened in Chrome 4 Nov 2026 (178 page 1 at full width and zoomed); 180-187 not opened.
seen.extent: MSS/7909/178: one letter of three images (letter, verso show-through, address), docketed '30 de Octob. 1546', French; the cipher is three lines of signs (about 75, mixes of 8, +, crossbar and ladder forms) in the lower half of the page. 7909/177 (Hungarian Estates, Trnava 11 Dec 1547, Latin) and 179 (Mary, 8 Dec 1547?) are clear.
seen.cipher: Short symbol cipher inside a clear French letter. In the left margin, opposite the signs, a contemporary hand has written 'pour les faire / partir sans / quelque advertissement' and small interlinear words stand above the preceding clear line, so a partial decipherment is on the leaf. The BNE summary says one letter of the ten has cipher; I did not check 7909/180-187.

prior_art.decode: known.py: the lead and the BNE/Hispana sweep only; not on DECODE.
prior_art.tomokiyo: spanish2C.htm fetched and grepped 4 Nov 2026: Reales Perez (2025) reconstructed Mary of Hungary's cipher of 1546 from two letters to Granvelle; those two are at the Real Biblioteca (RB II/2293), not BNE MSS/7909/178.
prior_art.lasry: No Lasry or HistoCrypt item on Mary of Hungary's ciphers found; GL.htm not located.
prior_art.edition: Reales Perez, 'Dechiffrer l'histoire', Estudios Romanicos 34 (2025) 159-177 (downloaded 4 Nov 2026): states that BNE, Besancon and the Real Biblioteca were searched, that only RB II/2293 ff. 185r-186v and 190r-190v used his cipher, and does not cite MSS/7909/178; Van Durme 1956 (Notes sur la correspondance de Granvelle), named in the BNE record, was not seen.
prior_art.literature: Pich-Ponce 2023 (Simon Renard-Granvelle ciphers) and Reales Perez 2025 are the studies; neither addresses this letter. Web search found no reading of MSS/7909/178.

vetting.key_check: No key held. Reales Perez's reconstructed 1546 table (from RB II/2293, a homophonic syllabary with numerals) and Pich-Ponce's PP1/PP3 were not available to test and the symbols here (8, +, ladder forms) were not matched to them; the marginal gloss gives only a few words.
vetting.key_in_volume: The marginal gloss on the leaf itself ('pour les faire partir sans quelque advertissement') is the only plaintext; no key sheet in 7909/177-179.
vetting.duplicates: known.py: no catalogue entry or target for MSS/7909/177-187; the neighbouring Hurtado letters (RES/261/73, MSS/20212/29) are different items.

1267.note: BNE MSS/20214/52 is a volume of originals and copies in the Ko.1 mixed nomenclator: the cipher letters 52/1, 4, 6, 10, 14 have contemporary 'A claro' copies filed with them (52/4b, 6b, 10b, 14b, 15) and 52/7 was read in part by Dudout on 4 Nov 2026 in targets/sessa1524; Bergenroth's CSP Spain III also prints the deciphered 1525-26 passages, so only 52/8 and 52/11 may be unclaimed and they were not matched.
1267.closed: Period 'claro' copies are filed with most of the cipher letters (viewer thumbnails and spreads of 52/1, 4b, 6b, 10b, 14b, 15) and 52/7 is already worked in targets/sessa1524 (contribution of 4 Nov 2026); closing the volume rather than promoting it, with 52/8 (21 Apr 1526) and 52/11 as the possible leftovers.

seen.extent: 20 items, 1524-1554 (BNE: 20 letters 1524-29 plus one of 1554): cipher originals headed 'Sa. Ce. Ca. Mt' at 52/4 (Rome 7 May 1524), 52/6 (4 Jun 1524), 52/7 (24 Jul 1524, 5 images), 52/8 (Rome 21 Apr 1526, 3 images), 52/10 (12 Jul 1526, 9 images), 52/11 (July 1525?, 7 images), 52/14 (17 Apr 1526, 7 images); clear letters at 52/1 (the claro of 14 Apr 1524), 52/3, 52/13, 52/16; clear copies headed 'Al Rey del Duque de Sessa ... A claro' at 52/4b, 52/6b, 52/10b, 52/14b, 52/15. About 10-25 cipher lines per letter by eye, not measured.
seen.cipher: Mixed nomenclator of three-letter code groups and signs set between clear Spanish sentences (e.g. 52/7 pp. 2-3 and 52/8 p. 2: columns of groups with no gloss on the leaf), the same system as RAH Salazar A-31 (R9873 ff.). 52/7 and 52/8 carry no interlinear or claro on the pages viewed; the claros 'A claro' are separate units with the same dates.
